summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/wasserstein_dice.py, exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, added a docs entry in docs/source/losses.rst, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py. Nothing was committed and no tests were run, per instructions. The formula is an approximation of Fidon et al. (2017): pairwise (1 - M[k,l]) weighting with generalized Dice class weights, using a plain Dice union in the denominator rather than the paper's transport-based denominator. Verify against the paper before merging. The test expected values were derived by hand and are unverified.
